name: Motorola Mobility
verdict: Owned by Lenovo, about a tenth of which the Chinese state owns indirectly.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): owned by Lenovo; the Chinese state holds about 9.5% of Lenovo through CAS Holdings and Legend.

why.text: Motorola belongs to Lenovo. Lenovo’s largest shareholder is Legend Holdings, with about a third, and Legend’s largest shareholder, with 29%, is a company wholly owned by the Chinese state. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So part of the money behind Motorola is the Chinese state’s.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.
